Hon'ble Mrs. Saroj Yadav,J.
Supplementary affidavit filed by learned counsel for the applicant is taken on record.
Heard Shri Satendra Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The instant anticipatory bail application has been moved by the accused-applicant- Vijay Kumar Alias Vijay Kumar Yadav, in Case Crime No.326 of 2022, under Section 409, 420 of I.P.C. Police Station Bazar Shukul, District Amethi with the prayer to enlarge him on anticipatory bail, as he is apprehending arrest in the above-mentioned case.

sentences.text: Mainly the allegation against the accused/applicant is that he chose the places other than the identified/marked by the authorities for construction of toilets and pits.
The accused applicant has not deviated from what has been directed by the authorities.
He further submitted that accused/applicant has criminal history of one case, which and has been explained by filing the supplementary affidavit today in the Court.
Thus, protection from arrest may be granted to the applicant.
Learned A.G.A. opposed the bail application and submitted that accused/applicant is a government employee and his case cannot be equated with M/s Saroj Enterprises and M/s Mahakal Construction.
He further submitted that an inquiry has been made wherein it is found that deviation has been made from the places for making toilets and pits.
Considered the rival submissions and perused the material available on record.

Keeping in view all the facts and circumstances of the case, nature of the crime and allegations made which have been specifically denied by the accused/applicant and also that accused persons representing M/s Saroj Enterprises and M/s Mahakal Construction have already been granted anticipatory bail by a co-ordinate bench of this Court, it appears just to grant anticipatory bail to the accused/applicant.
Thus the instant anticipatory bail application moved on behalf of the applicant- Vijay Kumar Alias Vijay Kumar Yadav is allowed.
